item.title: Air Force One will be repainted as Trump has hinted, US military says
item.description: A “red, white, gold and dark blue paint scheme” will be used for the jet.

item.title: Infleqtion becomes first quantum firm of its kind to go public
item.description: Investors appeared enthusiastic about Infleqtion’s (NYSE: INFQ) stock Tuesday, the first day the Boulder-based quantum-technology company was traded on New York Stock Exchange.

item.title: Guide company leading group caught in deadly avalanche warned of snow conditions days before incident
item.description: In a video posted to social media, the company urged people to "use extra caution" due to the avalanche danger.

item.title: Colorado aims to end 3-point drought against Oklahoma State
item.description: Tad Boyle described the finishing sequence of last week’s overtime loss at BYU as a “make-miss” scenario. BYU hit its shots at crunch time. The Buffaloes did not.

item.title: Man who lived rent-free in New Yorker Hotel, then claimed to own it, pleads guilty to fraud charge
item.description: Mickey Barreto lived for years in the hotel rent-free after invoking an obscure tenant protection.

item.title: Colorado abortion assistance fund reports record year, with 40% of patients it helped from Texas
item.description: Nearly 40% of the $1.74 million spent on abortion procedures last year went to help Texans, according to the Cobalt Abortion Fund -- second only to Coloradans, who received about 48% of that money.

item.title: 83-year-old woman missing; car spotted in Boulder, police say
item.description: The woman drove south from Fort Collins in a gold Kia Rio, according to police.

item.title: Fairview finishes second at 5A swim meet behind Lexi Byrn’s win in the butterfly
item.description: Fairview takes second at the 5A state meet as Lexi Byrn wins the 100 butterfly.

item.title: Adams succeeds Pilkington at KCI helm
item.description: Jared Adams took over in January as president of Longmont-based Krische Construction Inc., succeeding Mark Pilkington, who is retiring after 40 years with the company known as KCI.

item.title: Boulder Flatirons baseball team punts 2026 season
item.description: The Boulder Flatirons, a collegiate wood-bat minor league baseball team, said in a news release last week that it will not play in the 2026 Front Range League season as result of a field-access conflict with the Boulder 64’s, another collegiate team.
